children: The U.K.'s annual growth forecasts are likely to be revised upwards following better-than-expected GDP data for July, Deutsche Bank's Sanjay Raja says in a note. U.K. annual GDP grew by 1.6% in July, better than the consensus forecast by economists in a WSJ survey of 1.1% growth. Monthly GDP rose 0.4% in July, above the consensus forecast of flat growth. "Annual GDP growth expectations will lift meaningfully on the back of this, with today's data likely to add at least a tenth to expectations," Raja says. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
